text: Professional positioning and knowledge structureApplied chemistry is an interdisciplinary subject that deeply integrates the fundamental theories of chemistry with engineering technology and industrial demands, with the core logic of "molecular design - performance regulation - application development". For example:At the micro level: Designing high-stability cathode materials for lithium batteries (such as LiNixCoyMnzO2) through quantum chemical calculations;Macroscopic application: Develop superhydrophobic coatings (such as self-cleaning glass) by applying the principles of interfacial chemistry, or optimize the petroleum cracking process through catalytic chemistry to increase gasoline yield.Its knowledge system spans fields such as chemistry, materials, chemical engineering, and the environment, and combines the theoretical depth of science with the practical attributes of engineering.
